content.description:
At CAI, we help deliver some of the world's most advanced mission critical facilities. From hyperscale data centres to complex digital infrastructure programmes, our teams ensure facilities are commissioned safely, efficiently and ready for operation from day one.

As our Mission Critical business continues to grow across Europe, we are seeking experienced Commissioning Project Managers to lead commissioning delivery on large scale data centre projects.

This is an opportunity to join a globally recognised commissioning consultancy and play a key role in projects supporting cloud computing, AI, and digital infrastructure.

What You'll Do

Lead commissioning programmes from construction through handover

Manage multidisciplinary commissioning teams including Electrical, Mechanical and Controls Engineers

Develop commissioning execution plans, schedules and procedures

Drive project safety culture and commissioning best practices

Coordinate contractors, vendors, client stakeholders and operations teams

Lead FATs, SATs, integrated systems testing (IST) and final turnover activities

Manage project reporting, risk registers, issue resolution and change control

Ensure successful project delivery against schedule, quality and performance objectives

Act as a trusted advisor to clients throughout the commissioning lifecycle

What We're Looking For

8+ years' experience in mission critical, data centre or complex infrastructure projects

Experience leading commissioning activities on large scale projects

Strong understanding of MEP systems and critical environments

Experience with commissioning plans, procedures and integrated testing

Excellent stakeholder management and leadership skills

Ability to operate in a fast-paced project environment

PMP or equivalent project management certification desirable

Able to work in the EU without sponsorship now or in the future

Why Join CAI?

Exposure to high profile hyperscale projects

International project opportunities

Strong technical and professional development support

Opportunity to work alongside recognised industry experts
